title: Builder's Elytra 2026
description: Changes the texture of the normal elytra item to the Builder's elytra texture instead, and also give you the cape and elytra if you don't have the real cape.
body:
With the new cape added to minecraft being Builder's cape 2026 i decided to make a texture pack that gives you the cape and the elytra version. and also changes the sprite of the normal elytra item in your inventory to a Builder's cape sprite.

  • Changes your cape and elytra to the builder's cape.

  • Changes the elytra item texture into builder's cape.

    If you enjoy this resource pack Please write a kind comment to support me, also check out my other resource packs: 1. 2.

    IF YOU WANNA USE ANY OF THE FILES IN THIS RESOURCE PACK MSG (necrodent) ON DISCORD.
